title: Unrestricted log-log-depth parity cylinder and odd-split bounds
statement: For fixed N0>=2, C>1 and A>1, every O-rooted depth-d(y) word has at most 2^{-d(y)} y+y/(log y)^A odd starts in (y,2y], where d(y)=ceil(C log2(log(2y)/log N0)). The analogous all-prefix split assertion bounds the odd next share by q<1 plus the same additive error.
first_seen: 2026-09-03; separated from the combined live-pressure record on 2026-09-09
counterexamples: For every sufficiently large k, some dyadic y_k with log y_k comparable to 2^k has at least y_k/(216 log y_k) odd starts with full word O E^(k+4) O^(d(y_k)-k-5). Every start in that cylinder reaches 1 at time k+5. Its mass exceeds the proposed bound when C>1,A>1.
On the same block the entire prefix cylinder O E^(k+4) is absorbed at 1, so its next odd share is 1. This contradicts the all-prefix version for any fixed q<1,A>1.
mathematical_domain: Juggler inverse trees and growing-depth cylinder counts
tested_range: The refutation is an infinite-family human proof from the even-block harmonic estimate and fixed OEE block-average production. Finite regression tests check identities and indexing only.
notes: The original definition quantified over all words despite the following prose requiring only bad words. The current H definition is restricted to bad words; H_q is restricted to bad prefixes. These restricted hypotheses and stopped live pressure remain unproved, and juggler_loglog_depth_cylinder_bound remains ACTIVE only with that corrected scope. This result excludes neither cycles nor escape.
